text: I talked to a friend who is an art historian, who explained the paintings to me, their history and what they meant to people at the time. That helped make them less scary. Later I went back to the museum with her, sober, in the morning when it was quiet. I also did some CBT exercises from a self-help book for the general anxiety. It's mostly fine now.

Ich habe mit einer Psychologin über meine Gesundheitsangst gesprochen und eine kurze Verhaltenstherapie gemacht. Dabei habe ich gelernt, mein Herzklopfen nicht mehr ständig zu überprüfen. Der Kardiologe hat mir außerdem ein Langzeit-EKG gemacht, was mich beruhigt hat. Langsam wieder mit Sport anzufangen, erst Spazierengehen, dann leichtes Joggen, war am wichtigsten.

The hospital treated my frostbite, and I saw a physiotherapist for months to learn to walk properly again. Psychologically, I was resistant to getting help because I felt I'd brought it on myself. My partner eventually insisted. I found a psychologist who works with people after accidents and medical trauma. We focused on the episodes of the white field, using grounding and gradual exposure to bright light and white rooms. I also took an SSRI for about a year for the depression.

I've stopped taking psychedelics entirely, which was a big decision because they had been part of my identity for ten years. Letting go of that identity has been part of the healing.

My friend and I eventually talked it all through. He said he'd been terrified of finding me dead. That conversation was hard but important.

I still struggle in winter.

Ich habe eine Trauerbegleiterin aufgesucht, mit der ich über meine Großeltern gesprochen habe. Das hat mir geholfen, die Schuldgefühle zu verarbeiten und mich an die schönen Zeiten mit ihnen zu erinnern. Irgendwann konnte ich ihr Grab wieder besuchen. Ich habe dort einen Brief vorgelesen, den ich ihnen geschrieben hatte. Das war sehr befreiend.

I journaled about it for a few weeks and then talked to my mum about my first year. She told me I'd had colic and that she'd been at the end of her rope, and sometimes had to put me down and leave the room to calm herself. It made sense and was oddly comforting to hear.

A few sessions with a counsellor, who helped with the fear of police and dogs. I volunteered at a dog shelter for a while as a kind of self-made exposure therapy. That worked surprisingly well. I don't go to squat parties anymore.

Ich habe eine Hyposensibilisierung gegen Wespengift begonnen, das gibt mir mehr Sicherheit. Mit einer Therapeutin habe ich an der Angst gearbeitet. Es ist besser geworden, aber im Sommer bin ich immer noch angespannt.

I didn't tell anyone except my wife for a long time. When the depression got bad, my wife pushed me to see our GP, who diagnosed paternal postnatal depression and referred me to a perinatal mental health service. I didn't know such a thing existed for fathers. The therapist there helped me with the shame and with bonding with my son. I also took an antidepressant for about eight months.

My wife and I did couples counselling, which gave her space to talk about how alone she'd felt during the birth. That was painful but necessary.

A dads' group at our local family centre helped me feel less like a monster. Other fathers had their own stories of not being present, for different reasons.

I haven't taken psychedelics since, and I don't plan to.

Ich habe eine Verhaltenstherapie gemacht, in der es vor allem um die Angst vor der Derealisation ging. Meine Therapeutin hat mir erklärt, dass Derealisation eine Schutzreaktion ist und nicht gefährlich. Das hat mir viel Angst genommen. Ich habe auch gelernt, mich mit Sinnesübungen zu erden, z.B. kaltes Wasser, starke Gerüche. Medikamente habe ich nicht genommen. Am meisten geholfen hat, wieder mit Freunden Zeit zu verbringen, auch wenn sie sich anfangs unwirklich angefühlt haben.
Short course of CBT for the panic in water. My partner sat with me while I took baths until it felt normal again. Showers only for a while.
No treatment, I just took the train after that.

Ich habe mich nach einigen Wochen an eine Beratungsstelle für häusliche Gewalt gewandt, um zu fragen, wie ich meiner Freundin helfen kann. Dort habe ich auch über meine eigenen Ängste gesprochen, was sehr hilfreich war. Später habe ich eine kurze Therapie gemacht. Meine Freundin hat sich inzwischen von ihm getrennt, und wir haben über alles geredet. Das hat mir sehr geholfen.
